sources.entry: AI Text Auditor – Free tool that scores text against 28 AI writing patterns and returns a risk score

summary.name: AI Text Auditor
summary.one_liner: A free browser-based checker that scans pasted text against 28 AI writing patterns and returns a risk score with severity levels and fix suggestions.
keywords: check if text sounds like ai
use_cases: checking a draft for AI-sounding writing patterns
reviewing text for em-dash and hedging overuse
getting fix suggestions for AI tells before publishing
scripting bulk text audits via JSON API
highlighting AI vocabulary in an article
summary.what_it_does: The page describes a free tool where you paste any text and receive a report of which of 28 AI writing patterns appear, each with a severity level and a fix suggestion. It runs in the browser. It also exposes a JSON API at POST /api/audit that takes a text field and returns a risk_score, findings with severity, sentence CoV, and Tier 1 density. The interface shows metrics for sentence CoV, word count, and AI vocabulary density, plus an option to highlight AI vocabulary in the text. The page names example patterns including em-dash overuse, hedging, vocabulary inflation, and passive voice.
notable: Checks 28 AI writing patterns with severity levels and fix suggestions
Runs in the browser and offers a JSON API for agents and scripts
Returns sentence CoV, Tier 1 density, and a risk score
Can highlight AI vocabulary in the text
caveats: API is rate limited to 60 requests per hour per IP
Page describes patterns as signals; it does not claim to verify whether text was written by AI
